queries.Context: Core model construction and tra: Transformer decoder genome foundation model with 24 layers and 3072 hidden size trained in two stages using 1024 and 10240 token sequences for DNA generation
queries.Context: Data strategy for learning dive: Training a large generative genome foundation model on curated environmental metagenomic sequences from oceans, lakes, forests, and soils to capture diverse uncultured genomic context and improve context-adherent DNA sequence generation
queries.Context: Preliminary design selection fo: Comparative evaluation of DNA tokenization methods including character-level, overlapping, non-overlapping k-mer, BPE, model architectures such as Transformers, state space models, mixture-of-experts, masked versus causal language modeling objectives for efficient genome foundation model pretraining, compression, expressiveness, GUE benchmark genome classification performance
queries.Context: Computational efficiency for la: Efficient inference for large-scale genome generation foundation models using group-query attention, FlashAttention-2, and vLLM optimized serving for DNA sequence synthesis
queries.Context: Missing standardized assessment: comprehensive automated evaluation suite for generative genome foundation models assessing context adherence and ground-truth similarity in DNA sequence generation using species classification by discriminative genome models ORF length and codon adaptation index
queries.Context: Testing species-specific contex: species classification evaluation of generated DNA sequences using discriminative genome foundation models DNABERT-2 HyenaDNA Nucleotide Transformers-V2 Caduceus on datasets of 1000 non-overlapping genome sequences from ten unique species for contextual fidelity
queries.Context: Testing biological plausibility: Biological plausibility evaluation of generated genome sequences through open reading frame length distributions, separate coding and non-coding datasets, and codon adaptation index distributions in well-characterized microbial species
queries.Context: Comparison with existing genera: Comparing state-of-the-art generative genome foundation models Evo and GenSLMs for DNA sequence generation using consistent inference hyperparameters, contextual adherence, biological plausibility, and computational efficiency.
queries.Context: Analysis of generalization and: Evaluation of generative genome foundation models using distributional-level metrics and pairwise sequence comparisons between generated and reference DNA sequences, with analysis of context sequence length effects from 500 to 16,000 base pairs.
